emma: Quick question — we need to finalise the deprecation timeline for implicit model selection (i.e., when clients don't pass `model` or version headers). What behaviour are we shipping and what's the notice window?

sanjay: Short answer: opt-in canary -> gradual cutover -> deprecation notice. More detail: plan is a 2-stage flow: enable a compat route for 30 days (canaries + telemetry), then switch clients to explicit failure-with-guidance and start a 90d deprecation timer.

maria: To add — for the compat route we return `warning` in response headers and increment metric `infra.model_implied.warning`. SDKs should surface a single-line deprecation warning. Example header we plan to emit: `X-Redwood-Warning: implicit-model-deprecation; see https://redwood.dev/deprecations#implicit-model`.

emma: If a client omits `model` and also doesn't send an `Accept-Version` header, do we route to the compat variant automatically? Or fail fast?

sanjay: During the 30d canary we route to compat variant by default and emit the header/warning. After canary, we switch to rejection if explicit model/version isn't provided. Rejection payload will be: `{\n  "error": "model_required",\n  "message": "Requests must include `model` or `Accept-Version`. See https://redwood.dev/docs/versioning"\n}`.

alex: How will this affect Dedicated/Private customers who pin versions? We shouldn't break pinned deployments.

sanjay: Pinned deployments are unaffected — pinning wins. The rejection only applies to requests resolved by the default selection logic (no pin + no header). Documenting that in the rollout notes.

maria: Heads up for SDK teams: we'll need minor SDK bumps that add explicit `model` arg and log the deprecation warning. Please plan a 2-week cutover window for SDK adoption.

emma: Can someone own the deprecation RFC and customer comms? I'll draft the RFC and the customer notice but need a review.

alex: I can take the integration test matrix (backwards/forwards compatibility + canary telemetry) and write a small harness to simulate clients with/without headers.

sanjay: Nice. Also want a brief smoke test: call `/v1/generate` without `model` and assert warning header during canary, assert 4xx after deprecation. Tagging metrics: `model.selection.implicit`, `model.selection.explicit`, `deprecation.warning_count`.

emma: Sounds good. I'll add a docs PR and a `changelog/deprecations` entry. Can we set the timeline in the RFC to: 2 weeks canary, then 90 days until enforcement?

maria: Agree on that timeline. Also let's add a soft-fail mode for internal staging where we still accept implicit but log at debug level.

sanjay: I'll add the server flag `--warn-implicit-models` (default true during canary, removed after enforcement) and a feature flag for customers who want extended transition windows.

deploy-bot: rollout created: implicit-model-deprecation-canary -> env: staging, workers: 12. See /rollouts/ID-98321
\alemma: (typo) — meant to say thanks. :thumbsup:

emma: Action items: 1) I draft RFC + customer notice (due EOD Wed) 2) Alex builds test harness (due next Tue) 3) Maria coordinates SDK bumps (heads-up to SDK leads) 4) Sanjay wires metrics + server flag.

sanjay: I'll PR the server change and the warning header this week, pinging here when ready for review.

emma: Perfect. If no objections I'll proceed with the RFC and add the timeline to the deprecation page.

alex: No objections from me. Thanks.

maria: All good.

emma: Closing loop — will post RFC link here when it's up.
